sentences.en: I am going to ascertain the truth of the matter.
sentences.zh: 我要查明这件事的真相。

sentences.en: It's difficult to ascertain the meaning of a hapax legomenon.
sentences.zh: 很难确定单次出现词的意思。

sentences.en: We will first ascertain the cause of the disaster.
sentences.zh: 我们将首先查明灾难的原因。

senses.zh: 弄清, 确定, 查明

mnemonic: 词根记忆：as（加强）+certain（确定）→一再区别→确定
